_: The defaults beside the gate. Your own table goes in ${REGATTA_CONFIG:-~/.config/regatta}/regatta/models.json and wins over this one row by row: a site it lacks runs its row here, with these defaults. bin/gate show | set | check.

example.classify.note: the table's shape; a module's call sites are rows in your own table

scope.upstream.note: Evolve S2 (docs/self-improvement-scope-pass-2026-10-30.md): the judge of a confidential scope's upstream lines, after scope-pass record's scan, before the exact bytes leave for the vault's inbox; claude only (bin/jev's confidential()), fail: no judge is no export

scope.brief.note: Evolve S11: aurora's bin/scope-pass check --judge and pickup's seed review, the judge of a brief leaving a confidential scope's node, after the word scan; claude only (bin/jev's confidential()); fail: no judge is no export

plan.stall.note: Evolve S11: helm's tick classifier (helm's bin/stalls_tick.py CLASSIFY_SITE), would a stalled run's last reply be retried (yes) or raised (no); fail closed: no answer is raised and asked again after an hour. A deployed table may point it at Jev with its tuned threshold

review-gate.reviewer.note: Evolve S11: wharf's bin/review-gate plan, which reviewer agent runs; claude only (the agents are Claude Code agents); the tier and effort logic stays in review-gate; off + skip names no agent

review-gate.code-review.note: Evolve S11: wharf's bin/review-gate plan, which /code-review agent runs; claude only; the level stays in review-gate; off + skip names no agent

review-gate.merge.note: Evolve S11: wharf's bin/review-gate merge, one call answering same defect? per pair and a severity per finding; off or failing, the lists come out unmerged and say so (the gate never blocks /finish)

review-gate.same-shadow.note: Evolve S11: wharf's bin/review-gate merge, the second answer to the same pairs; off here, so a stranger's install logs 'shadow off'; a deployed table points it at Jev (the 2026-10-19 verdict) and batch 1

sparks.shape.note: Evolve S11: sextant's bin/sparks, the call that shapes a note; the pass waits when it is off, a note needs its shaping call

sparks.route.note: Evolve S11: sextant's bin/sparks, the call that says where a note belongs; off, the note stays where it was filed

sparks.redact.note: Evolve S11: sextant's bin/sparks, the sensitive-sentence judge before a transcript is shaped; off + fail until the owner approves a vendor for the guarded source in sextant's config (redact_approved): a pass that asks for redaction is refused, never run unredacted

keel.comment.note: routed comments S4: the lookout's one call on an owner's free-text page comments, after keel's rules (judge section 3); skip, so an outage makes every such thread T2; keel routed bench reruns the evidence's ten

evolve.critic.note: Evolve S5: aurora's bin/evolve critic, the scope pass's blinded critic over the findings artefact, never told the owner's preference; claude only; skip, so an outage leaves the deterministic checks alone

evolve.ask.note: Evolve S1: plumb's bin/asks, the owner's typed prompts through four batched calls a week (target, kind, level, detectability); the prompt and label set are Ring 0 (owner-merged); skip, so an outage is a sieve-only week the rows say

evolve.theme.note: Evolve S1: plumb's bin/asks, one call a week naming each improvement ask's theme, and once a month the theme merge pass (asks merge), as a kebab slug of the need (never the owner's words), reusing the ledger's slugs; off or failing, a hashed-word overlap stands in (it scored F1 0.16 against the hand themes, so the repeat share is read low then)

evolve.match.note: Evolve S1: plumb's bin/asks, each detectable ask against the findings dated before it, labelled anticipated, M1-M7 or J; Ring 0 like evolve.ask; idle until S3/S5 write findings
